Given:

\n\n

Time taken by A to complete the work = 9 days

\n\n

Time taken by B to complete the work = 12 days

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Total work = L.C.M. of (12, 9) = 36 units

\n\n

Efficiency of A = 36/9 = 4 units/day

\n\n

Efficiency of B = 36/12 = 3 units/day

\n\n

Combined efficiency of A and B = (3 + 4) = 7 units/day

\n\n

If they work together on it for 5 days = 7 × 5 = 35 unit

\n\n

The fraction of the work left is = 1/36

\n\n

The fraction of the work left is 1/36

\n\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

A द्वारा कार्य को पूरा करने में लिया गया समय = 9 दिन

\n\n

B द्वारा कार्य को पूरा करने में लिया गया समय = 12 दिन

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

कुल कार्य = (12, 9) का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य = 36 इकाइयाँ

\n\n

A की दक्षता = 36/9 = 4 इकाई/दिन

\n\n

B की दक्षता = 36/12 = 3 इकाई/दिन

\n\n

A और B की संयुक्त दक्षता = (3 + 4) = 7 इकाई/दिन

\n\n

यदि वे इस पर 5 दिनों तक एक साथ कार्य करते हैं = 7 × 5 = 35 इकाई

\n\n

शेष कार्य का अंश = 1/36 

\n\n

शेष कार्य का अंश 1/36 है।

Given:

\n\n

An aeroplane travels five times as fast as a bus.

\n\n

Time is taken by bus to cover 60 km = 1 hour 20 minutes(4/3 hour)

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Speed = Distance/time

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Speed of bus = 60/(4/3)

\n\n

⇒ 45 km/hr

\n\n

Speed of aeroplane = 5 × 45

\n\n

⇒ 225 km/hr

\n\n

Distance covered in 25 minutes = 225 × 25/60

\n\n

⇒ 93.75 km

\n\n

Distance covered in 25 minutes by aeroplane is 93.75 km/hr. 

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

एक हवाई जहाज एक बस की तुलना में पाँच गुना तेज गति से यात्रा करता है।

\n\n

बस द्वारा 60 किमी की दूरी तय करने में लगा समय = 1 घंटा 20 मिनट (4/3 घंटे)

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

गति = दूरी/समय

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

बस की गति = 60/(4/3)

\n\n

⇒ 45 किमी/घंटा

\n\n

हवाई जहाज की गति = 5 × 45

\n\n

⇒ 225 किमी/घंटा

\n\n

25 मिनट में तय की गई दूरी = 225 × 25/60

\n\n

⇒ 93.75 किमी

\n\n

हवाई जहाज 25 मिनट में 93.75 किमी की दूरी तय करेगा।

Simple Interest = (Principle × Rate per annum ×Time)/100

\n\n

Let deposit = Rs. a 

\n\n

⇒ 135 = (a x 4.5 x 1)/100

Now,

Simple interest on 5% = (3000 x 5 x 1)/100

⇒ 150

\n\n

∴ Additional interest  in one year = Rs. 15

\n\n

⇒ 1 = 30

\n\n

⇒ 5 = 5 x 30 = 150

\n\n

\n\n

∴ Additional interest in one year is 15.

Formula Used:

\n\n

Circumradius of Equilateral triangle = side of equilateral triangle/√3

\n\n

Concept Used:

\n\n

Centroid Divide the median in the ratio 2 : 1

\n\n

All the centres of the Equilateral triangle lie at the same point. Be it circumcenter, orthocenter, incentre, and centroid.

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\n\n

Since all the centres lie at the same point L, PL is also the circumradius of Equilateral Triangle PQR

\n\n

Using the above formula,

\n\n

PL = PQ/√3

\n\n

⇒ PL = 6/√3

\n\n

⇒ PL = 2√3 cm.

\n\n

∴ The length of PL is 2√3 cm.

Given:

\n\n

A, B and C together can finish the task in 12 days

\n\n

A and B alone can finish the task in 36 days

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Time taken = Total work/Efficiency

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Total work be 36 units (lcm of 12 and 36)

\n\n

A, B and C together can finish a task in 12 days

\n\n

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 36/12

\n\n

= 3 units per day

\n\n

Efficiency of (A) = 36/36 = 1 unit per day.

\n\n

Efficiency of (B) = 36/36 = 1 unit per day.

\n\n

Efficiency of C = 3 - 2 = 1 unit per day

\n\n

C alone complete the same work = 36/1 = 36 days

\n\n

Shortcut Trick

\n\n

1-day work of (A + B + C) and (A) and (B) = (1/12) - (1/36) - (1/36) = 1/36

\n\n

Total time taken by C alone = 36 days.

\n\n

A और B अकेले-अकेले समान कार्य को 36 दिनों में कर सकते हैं।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

लिया गया समय = कुल कार्य/दक्षता

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

कुल कार्य 36 इकाइयाँ (12 और 36 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य)

\n\n

A, B और C मिलकर एक कार्य को 12 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं।

\n\n

(A + B + C) की दक्षता = 36/12

\n\n

= 3 इकाई प्रति दिन

\n\n

A की दक्षता = 36/36 = 1 इकाई प्रति दिन

\n\n

B की दक्षता = 36/36 = 1 इकाई प्रति दिन

\n\n

C की दक्षता = 3 - 1 - 1 = 1 इकाई प्रति दिन

\n\n

C अकेले उसी कार्य को पूरा करता है = 36/1 = 36 दिनों में

\n\n

Shortcut Trick

(A + B + C) और (A) और (B) का 1 दिन का कार्य = (1/12) - (1/36) - (1/36) = 1/36

\n\n

C अकेले उसी कार्य को पूरा करता है = 36 दिनों में

Formula used:

\n\n

Average of N numbers = sum of N numbers/N

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Average demand of all 3 companies = (3800 + 4532 + 5318)/3 = 4550

\n\n

Average production of all 3 companies = (3620 + 2829 + 2833)/3 = 3094

\n\n

Required difference = 4550 - 3094 = 1456

\n\n

∴ The correct answer is 1456.

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

N संख्याओं का औसत = N संख्याओं का योग / N

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

तीनों कंपनियों की औसत मांग = (3800 + 4532 + 5318)/3 = 4550

\n\n

तीनों कंपनियों का औसत उत्पादन = (3620 + 2829 + 2833)/3 = 3094

\n\n

अभीष्ट अंतर = 4550 - 3094 = 1456

\n\n

∴ सही उत्तर 1456 है।

\n", "te": "

ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

\n\n

N సంఖ్యల సగటు = N సంఖ్యల మొత్తం/N

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

అన్ని 3 కంపెనీల సగటు డిమాండ్ = (3800 + 4532 + 5318)/3 = 4550

\n\n

అన్ని 3 కంపెనీల సగటు ఉత్పత్తి = (3620 + 2829 + 2833)/3 = 3094

\n\n

అవసరమైన తేడా = 4550 - 3094 = 1456

\n\n

∴ సరైన సమాధానం 1456.

\n", "mr": "

वापरलेले सूत्र:

\n\n

N संख्यांची सरासरी = N संख्यांची बेरीज/N

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

तिन्ही कंपन्यांची सरासरी मागणी = (3800 + 4532 + 5318)/3 = 4550

\n\n

तिन्ही कंपन्यांचे सरासरी उत्पादन = (3620 + 2829 + 2833)/3 = 3094

\n\n

आवश्यक फरक = 4550 - 3094 = 1456

\n\n

∴ 1456 हे योग्य उत्तर आहे.

\n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "An undigestible criticism would have been raised by one group of the club against the manager."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "An undigestible criticism was being raised by one group of the club against the&nbsp;manager."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "An undigestible criticism had been raised by one group of the club against the manager."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "An undigestible criticism has been raised by one group of the club against the manager."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is "An undigestible criticism has been raised by one group of the club against the manager."\n\n

Key Points

\n\n
    \n\t
  • The given sentence is in Present Perfect Tense and Active Voice.
    • \n\t
  • The rule for changing a Present Perfect Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
    • \n\t
  • Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
    • \n\t
  • The subject is "one group of the club" and object is "an undigestible criticism" in active voice.
    • \n\t
  • So, the subject is "an undigestible criticism" and object is "One group of the club" in passive voice.
    • \n\t
  • Structure:\n\t
      \n\t\t
    • Subject + has/have + V3 + Object (Active Voice)
      • \n\t\t
    • Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject (Passive Voice)
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n\t
  • Example:\n\t
      \n\t\t
    • Disha has arranged things. (Active Voice)
      • \n\t\t
    • Things have been arranged by Disha. (Passive Voice)
      • \n\t
    \n\t
    • \n\t
  • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.
    • \n
\n\n

​​Correct sentence: An undigestible criticism has been raised by one group of the club against the manager.

In 1957, the Soviet Sputnik was the first to be launched into space. There are currently a number of artificial satellites launched into space by various nations.

      \n\n

      Additional Information

        • \n\t
      • Tossed: to throw something lightly and carelessly. (किसी वस्‍तु को हलके से और लापरवाही से फेंकना, उछालना)

        • \n
      \n\n

      ​How does a satellite get started? It is typically launched into space by means of a rocket. After ascending into the thinner air layers above the earth, the satellite is released from the rocket. For a successful satellite launch, a rocket's speed is carefully calculated and controlled. Every object in space is pushed toward the earth's centre by gravity. The inertia of motion will propel the object into space if it has its own velocity of motion. When the orbital velocity is exactly right, these two opposing forces are balanced, causing the satellite to move toward the earth while still hovering over its surface.
